transitions.note: recordSupport (distinct records) is the primary weight; occurrenceCount is diagnostic only. A transition repeated inside one long message adds at most +1 recordSupport.

drivingForceStrategy.note: Tier A/B are record-grounded couplings. exploratory is prior-only/weak and must NOT be read as validated (§6). Character prior existing is not evidence.

affectStrategy.note: simultaneous and sequential blends are reported separately and never merged (§8).

triggerSensitivity.note: No activation numbers or curves (§7). Low-trigger+high-activation is a candidate, not a law.

maskRate.uncertainty_note: n=50 pilot — rate indicates whether this deserves testing at larger n, not a law

revealMask.note: A retract is only counted as a mask when it directly follows a reveal-type move (§21.7). revealWithoutMask lists the counter-scenes — she does not always mask after exposing need.

relationshipOperations.note: Directional operations only. No +/- magnitudes are produced (§10).

partnerOperations.note: These are EXPECTED partner operations declared by the annotation, NOT observed partner turns. Single-sided corpus cannot confirm the partner actually did them (§11/§14).

performancePatterns.note: Performance is detected from performance ACTIONS / awareness tags, NOT from public/private target alone (§21.14). privateContextPerformance shows performance also occurs off-stage.

intraMessageMomentum.note: Intra-message arcs only. No partner turn exists in evidence, so these are NOT cross-turn conversation grammar (§14). possible_next_strategy is deliberately left unknown.
